description: A CI pipeline: a commit triggers build, then tests, then deploy; a failure stops the pipeline.
raw:
{"name": "CI Pipeline", "summary": "Commits run through build, test, and deploy stages on shared runners; any failure immediately stops the pipeline.",
 "places": [
  {"id": "queued_commits", "label": "Queued commits", "description": "Commits waiting for an available CI runner.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "runners_available", "label": "Available runners", "description": "Idle CI runner slots ready to execute jobs.", "initial": 2, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "building", "label": "Building", "description": "Jobs currently compiling source code and dependencies.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "testing", "label": "Testing", "description": "Jobs running automated unit and integration test suites.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "deploying", "label": "Deploying", "description": "Jobs pushing verified artifacts to the deployment target.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "deployed", "label": "Deployed", "description": "Successful pipelines that completed deployment.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "build_failed", "label": "Build failed", "description": "Pipelines halted due to compilation or build errors.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "test_failed", "label": "Test failed", "description": "Pipelines halted due to failing automated tests.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0},
  {"id": "deploy_failed", "label": "Deploy failed", "description": "Pipelines halted due to deployment errors.", "initial": 0, "capacity": 0}],
 "transitions": [
  {"id": "push_commit", "label": "Push commit", "description": "A developer pushes a new commit to trigger the pipeline.", "rate": 4},
  {"id": "start_build", "label": "Start build", "description": "A runner claims a queued commit and begins the build.", "rate": 120},
  {"id": "build_pass", "label": "Build succeeds", "description": "The build completes successfully and advances to tests.", "rate": 10.8},
  {"id": "build_fail", "label": "Build fails", "description": "The build fails and stops the pipeline.", "rate": 1.2},
  {"id": "test_pass", "label": "Tests pass", "description": "All tests pass and the pipeline advances to deploy.", "rate": 5.4},
  {"id": "test_fail", "label": "Tests fail", "description": "One or more tests fail and halt the pipeline.", "rate": 0.6},
  {"id": "deploy_pass", "label": "Deploy succeeds", "description": "The deployment succeeds and finishes the run.", "rate": 11.4},
  {"id": "deploy_fail", "label": "Deploy fails", "description": "The deployment fails and halts the pipeline.", "rate": 0.6}],
 "arcs": [
  {"from": "push_commit", "to": "queued_commits", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "queued_commits", "to": "start_build", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "runners_available", "to": "start_build", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "start_build", "to": "building", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "building", "to": "build_pass", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "build_pass", "to": "testing", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "building", "to": "build_fail", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "build_fail", "to": "build_failed", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "build_fail", "to": "runners_available", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "testing", "to": "test_pass", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "test_pass", "to": "deploying", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "testing", "to": "test_fail", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "test_fail", "to": "test_failed", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "test_fail", "to": "runners_available", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "deploying", "to": "deploy_pass", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "deploy_pass", "to": "deployed", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "deploy_pass", "to": "runners_available", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "deploying", "to": "deploy_fail", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "deploy_fail", "to": "deploy_failed", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false},
  {"from": "deploy_fail", "to": "runners_available", "weight": 1, "inhibitor": false}],
 "assumptions": ["Rates are per hour.", "There are 2 concurrent runners available by default.", "Commits arrive at an average rate of 4 per hour.", "A single runner remains assigned to the pipeline across all stages until success or failure.", "Build takes ~5 minutes with a 90% pass rate.", "Tests take ~10 minutes with a 90% pass rate.", "Deploy takes ~5 minutes with a 95% pass rate."]}
